errors.evidence: The legend is located on the right side of the chart, vertically centered, not specifically in the upper right corner.

The description first identifies 2014 as the year with the lowest yield (approx. 130,000 tons), and then states that for the 'remaining years' the yield varies between 130,000 and 220,000 tons. This is incorrect, as the lowest yield for the remaining years (2016-2022) is in 2020, at approximately 158,000 tons, not 130,000 tons.
